name: Deploy
short_description: Bash script for packaging and deploying projects via curl-to-bash with AES-256 encryption.
long_description: Deploy is a bash-based deployment utility that enables secure project distribution through encrypted packages. It allows developers to package entire directories, upload them to Backblaze B2 storage via rclone, and generate single-line curl commands for installation. The system uses AES-256-CBC encryption with PBKDF2 key derivation to secure packages during transit and storage. Deployment recipients can execute the generated curl-to-bash command without pre-configuration, and optional entrypoint.sh scripts can run post-deployment setup. Ideal for distributing applications that need secure, scriptable deployment with minimal dependencies.

modules.description: Main deployment script with commands for init (configure settings), package (compress and encrypt directories), deploy (download and decrypt packages), and install (self-install to /usr/local/bin).
